$comment: SHARED CONTRACT (VVV-128 / T1.1 / ADRs 0003, 0005, 0009). Hand-authored flat HEX is the single source of values; the generator (T1.2) emits tokens.web.css (OKLCH) and tokens.ts (hex/rgba). Per ADR 0009, color is split into two conceptual buckets: brand + status are MODE-AGNOSTIC (read as Kilo on any background); surface, foreground, border, shadow are DARK-ONLY with NO light/dark pairing. Do not add a light-mode set. Names are stable; cloud styles, skills, and product rollouts depend on them. Edit values live in /playground (open playground/index.html).

brand.$comment: Mode-agnostic. ADR 0005: primary IS brand IS #EDFF00 (one token). `foreground` is near-black for AA contrast on the neon. hover/dim/ring are hand-picked here; the web generator may recompute them from primary via oklch(from ...).

status.$comment: Mode-agnostic status hues (ADR 0009). 500 = base/solid, 400 = brighter foreground/hover. Resolve a semantic status name to a hue family via `statusDomain` below.

surface.$comment: DARK-ONLY elevation ladder (ADR 0009). Higher = lighter, the dark-mode way to express elevation (shadows alone are near-invisible on near-black). Value, not hue, creates hierarchy.

foreground.$comment: DARK-ONLY text/icon colors, paired with surfaces. default = primary text, muted = secondary/metadata, subtle = disabled/tertiary, onSurface mirrors default for clarity. onStatus is the bright text color to use on translucent status fills.

border.$comment: DARK-ONLY. Translucent white overlays (a recognizable Kilo move) so borders composite correctly on any surface in the ladder. inputBg is the faint translucent fill for inputs.

shadow.$comment: DARK-ONLY, SECONDARY elevation cue (surfaces do the primary work). CSS box-shadow value strings. Terminal/CLI ignore these.

statusDomain.$comment: Status domain -> status hue family. Consumers resolve e.g. cloud -> blue -> color.status.blue500 / blue400.

typography.$comment: Compact, tool-first hierarchy. Sans: Inter. Mono: Roboto Mono (first-class given VS Code + JetBrains + CLI). Body is 14px/1.5 by default.
